text:
mike: Quick sync: proposal to add a "warmup-token" bucket separate from burst credits to pay for VM start + model load.

tara: why separate vs tag existing bursts?

mike: two reasons: billing clarity and refill semantics. warmup tokens refill slowly so steady traffic can't exhaust them.

sam: sketch config:
```yaml
autoscaler:
  strategy: hybrid
  warmup_token:
    seed: 3
    refill_rate: 1/hour
    cap: 12
  predictive:
    window: 6m
  reactive:
    tail_ms: 300
```

tara: billing question: who pays during prewarm streaming?

mike: predictive prewarms are tenant reservations (tenant charged). reactive prewarms drawn from subsidized pool per plan; over-cap -> bill or deny.

sam: operator API should accept AdmitIntent with fields: tenant, gpus_needed, token_estimate, expected_model_hash, ttl_s. Support dry_run.

mike: add metrics: warmup_tokens_used_total, warmup_refills, predictive_prewarms, reactive_prewarms, prewarm_failures. alert when predictive_prewarms > 40% headroom.

ops-bot: staging-note: dry_run endpoint implemented. canary=3% tenants. metrics emitted for predictive_prewarms.

tara: rollout: opt-in -> small canary -> tiered enable. operator kill-switch required.

mike: next: short RFC addendum + proto + PromQL samples. I'll draft and ping reviewers. :rocket:
